hero.title: Hello, I'm Esteban Quillerier
hero.subtitle: Fullstack web developer student available for internships and freelance.

presentation.text:
I'm a second-year full-stack web development student based in Orléans, France.
I enjoy building applications from backends and databases to user interfaces, and I'm always looking to expand my technical skills.
I'm currently looking for an internship where I can contribute to projects, learn from experienced developers, and gain professional experience. I'm also open to freelance opportunities and small web development projects.

about.about_me:
I'm a second-year full-stack web development student at Coda in Orléans, France. I'm interested in both backend and frontend development and enjoy understanding how the different parts of an application work together.
I've worked on individual and group projects involving web applications, databases, APIs, desktop applications and command-line tools. I'm comfortable learning new technologies when a project requires them and enjoy working through technical problems to find practical solutions.
I'm currently looking for an internship where I can gain experience. I'm also interested in freelance opportunities where I can help build or improve web applications.
Outside of development, I enjoy traveling, learning about different cultures, painting, 3D modelling, microcontrollers and arachnology. I'm also currently working on improving my Tagalog.

project.text: A few of the projects I've worked on during my first year of studies and personal development. These projects cover web development, backend systems, desktop applications, game development and command-line tools.

notSpot.title: NotSpot
notSpot.description:
Music streaming application built as a first-year final project. The application combines a user-facing interface with backend services and a database to manage the platform's music catalogue.

This project allowed me to work with Dart, Flutter, Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and Docker.

terminalPortfolio.title: Terminal portfolio
terminalPortfolio.description:
My first personal portfolio, designed to behave like a terminal interface.

Built while learning JavaScript, with a focus on DOM manipulation, animations and user input handling. The project also introduced me to Docker, deployment and maintaining a personal web project.

suggestibility.title: Suggestibility study application
suggestibility.description:
Application commissioned by a psychologist to conduct tests evaluating suggestibility in children.

Developed as part of a five-person team and delivered according to the client's requirements and deadline. The application was designed to be portable and configurable, allowing the user to modify test questions and content without changing the application itself.

The project also required us to consider confidentiality requirements concerning patient information.

codBlast.title: Cod'Blast
codBlast.description: GameJam project submitted as a Javascript final exam. Made with a group of 2 other people, made to play like BlockBlast, deployed on github pages.

email.title: Email sender CLI
email.description:
Command-line application written in C for sending emails to users stored in a database.

Built with performance and resource usage in mind, using libpq to interact with PostgreSQL. The tool was created to automate update emails for the NotSpot project.
